headline: Andreas Rödder: «The pendulum is swinging to the right»
lead: Historian Andreas Rödder sees Germany facing a «paradigm shift of the political system.» The AfD is polling at around 30%. For Rödder, the question therefore arises whether The Union can catch the «pendulum» in the right-wing center.
seo_title: Andreas Rödder: «The pendulum is swinging to the right»
summary_bullets_en: Historian Andreas Rödder views Germany as facing a "paradigm shift in the political system."
The AfD is polling at around 30 percent, raising questions about the Union's position on the right-center spectrum.
key_questions_de: Wie beeinflusst die AfD den politischen Paradigmenwechsel in Deutschland?
Kann die Union das Pendel in der rechten Mitte auffangen?
Welche Rolle spielt Andreas Rödder in der Analyse des Rechtsrucks?

original_de.headline: Andreas Rödder: «Das Pendel schwingt nach rechts»
